dashboard.label: Security Audit
dashboard.description: Security posture of the Splunk deployment: authentication activity and failed logins, the user/role inventory, privileged configuration changes, TLS/SSL configuration, world-writable knowledge objects, and access to sensitive REST endpoints. All searches run against index=_audit, index=_internal, and Splunk's own authentication/authorization/server REST endpoints - no add-on required. Note: login events reflect Splunk's local authentication logging; if the deployment uses SSO/SAML in front of Splunk, failed-login visibility here may be partial.

search.query: | rest /services/authentication/users splunk_server=local | search roles=admin | stats count
`audit_login_events` info=failed | fillnull value="(unknown)" user | stats count by user | sort -count | head 15 | rename user as User, count as "Failed Attempts"
| rest /services/authentication/users splunk_server=local | table title, roles, type, email, realname, "locked-out" | rename title as User, type as "Auth Type", "locked-out" as "Locked Out"

| rest /services/authorization/roles splunk_server=local | eval CapabilityCount=mvcount(capabilities) | table title, CapabilityCount, srchIndexesAllowed, srchIndexesDefault, imported_roles | rename title as Role, CapabilityCount as "# Capabilities", srchIndexesAllowed as "Indexes Allowed", srchIndexesDefault as "Default Indexes", imported_roles as "Inherits From"

| rest /services/authentication/providers/LDAP splunk_server=local | eval Encrypted=if(match(SSL,"(?i)^(1|true)$"),"LDAPS (encrypted)","Plain LDAP (unencrypted)") | table title, host, port, Encrypted, bindDN, userBaseDN, groupBaseDN | rename title as Strategy, host as Host, port as Port, bindDN as "Bind DN", userBaseDN as "User Base DN", groupBaseDN as "Group Base DN"

index=_audit (action=edit_user OR action=edit_roles OR action=edit_authentication OR action=change_authentication) earliest=-7d | table _time, user, action, info | sort -_time | head 25 | rename user as User, action as Action, info as Result

| rest /services/server/settings splunk_server=* | eval WebSSL=if(match('enableSplunkWebSSL',"(?i)^(1|true)$"),"Enabled","DISABLED") | table splunk_server, WebSSL | sort splunk_server | rename splunk_server as "Splunk Server"

| rest /services/configs/conf-server splunk_server=* | search title=sslConfig | eval MgmtSSL=if(match('enableSplunkdSSL',"(?i)^(0|false)$"),"DISABLED","Enabled") | table splunk_server, MgmtSSL | sort splunk_server | rename splunk_server as "Splunk Server"

panel.title: Globally Shared Saved Searches Writable by Everyone

search.query: | rest /services/saved/searches splunk_server=local | search "eai:acl.sharing"="global" "eai:acl.perms.write"="*" | table title, "eai:acl.app", "eai:acl.owner" | rename title as "Saved Search", "eai:acl.app" as App, "eai:acl.owner" as Owner

index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd_access earliest=-24h (uri="*authentication/users*" OR uri="*authorization/roles*" OR uri="*data/indexes*" OR uri="*server/settings*") | stats count by user, uri, status | sort -count | head 20 | rename user as User, uri as Endpoint, status as "HTTP Status", count as Calls
